list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guides below are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources by name; no guide text is copied from another guide. Where published guides disagree, the guide says so.
sources_note: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophy list; Official PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the small cleanup jobs. Keep this tracker ticked as you go and the platinum will arrive on its own.
trophies.guide_short: The platinum. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — no separate task.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so you cannot miss it: follow the on-screen prompts, finish the sequence, and the trophy pops when the mission completes. No side task is needed.
trophies.guide_short: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is unmissable — just play the story to the end of it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock on the chapter's final mission, so keep playing the main story in order and this will pop at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one missable job in this guide — the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — because that spot is tied to Chapter 1.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 1's story missions. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first — see Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable: play the main story through, and it pops when the chapter's last mission ends. Use the quiet stretches between missions for collectibles that are already open.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 2's story missions. Unmissable — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. It pops at the end of the chapter's final mission, so there is nothing extra to prepare. If you are chasing the 100% checklist at the same time, the activities that open up in this part of the story are worth trying once for Master of None.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 3's story missions. Unmissable — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. It pops when the chapter's last mission ends. By now most of the map and most activities are open, so this is a good point to start the longer grinds — stunts, shooting-range medals and card sets — between story missions.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 4's story missions. Unmissable — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This gold trophy is the story's end: play the main missions to the last one and complete it, and the trophy pops. Everything else in the game stays open in free roam afterwards, so do not rush the cleanup jobs before the finale.
trophies.guide_short: Finish the final story mission. Gold, unmissable — free roam stays open afterwards for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a main-mission trophy, so it pops when that mission ends. Mission trophies cannot be missed: replaying a mission is not needed, just finish it once.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-mission trophy that pops at the mission's end. Heist missions are long, so follow the mission objectives in order and do not leave the mission area early.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops when that mission ends. As with every mission trophy, the only requirement is finishing the mission once.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when that mission ends. Mission trophies are unmissable, so play the story in order and this will come on its own.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when that mission ends. The airport setting also makes this a good mission to remember for Catch Me If You Can, which is about leaving VCIA in an unscheduled way in free roam.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when that mission ends. Expect a heavy combat mission, so stock up on armour and ammo before starting it rather than during it.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen. That means the full story, plus the checklist the game itself counts: stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the other counted jobs. Work through this tracker in roadmap order and check the in-game percentage after each block — it is the only number that matters for this gold trophy, and it pops the moment it hits 100%.
trophies.guide_short: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats. Story plus every counted strand, collectible and activity.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like, as the game counts them. Do not grind them one by one: stunts stack up naturally while you drive fast, take jumps and play the story, so start counting early and finish the remainder in free roam with a fast car and a ramp-heavy route. The in-game stats screen shows your running total.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 250 stunts in total. They build up naturally while driving fast — finish the rest in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The list covers the game's side activities — fishing, shooting range, drone races, racing, arcade games, bowling and the rest of the activities this guide lists. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so sample them as they open up during the story and tick each off here as you go.
trophies.guide_short: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sampling is enough — no win needed for any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the range, work through the challenges weapon by weapon, and repeat any challenge until it clears gold — silver or bronze does not count. Take your time on the later, tighter challenges and learn each one's target pattern before rushing the timer.
trophies.guide_short: Gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Repeat any challenge until it clears gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race, so you need a win at every one, not 14 wins at the same spot. Learn each course's tight corners first at a slower pace, then race it for the win; the drone handles very differently from a car, so short practice runs pay off.
trophies.guide_short: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. One win per location — learn each course first.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replaying the same race does not count twice — you need 20 distinct race events won. Work through the race list across Leonida, picking races that suit the car you have, and tick each win off in this tracker so you do not repeat one by mistake.
trophies.guide_short: Win 20 different races. Replays of the same race do not count — win 20 distinct events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are about reeling in the better catch, so watch the line tension, reel steadily rather than yanking, and take the challenge when you have decent gear. One win against Cal is all it takes.
trophies.guide_short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Reel steadily, watch the tension, and one win is enough.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish it, not just start it. Find an arcade machine, pick a game, and play it through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so choose the one you find easiest and finish that one.
trophies.guide_short: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish. Pick the easiest machine and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is a chain of missions: keep taking his missions when they appear until the last one is offered, then finish it. Side-character final missions are unmissable in free roam as long as you keep accepting that character's missions.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Andy's final mission. Keep taking his missions until the last one appears, then finish it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Work through Kenton's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. If his missions stop appearing, check the map for his marker and advance the main story a little — strands often unlock with story progress.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Kenton's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. Biker-style missions reward a good bike and a steady pace over rushing.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Billy's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as markers on the map — talk to the stranger, finish their chain, and count it. You need 8 full strands, not 8 single missions, so keep following each stranger until their story ends. This silver is one of the biggest blocks in the 100% checklist, so start it early.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands. Eight whole chains, not eight single missions.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. Keep accepting his missions as they show up and the finale will unlock.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Randy's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Work through Tyrone's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. His missions are part of the stranger-style chains that also feed Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: the first spot is the balcony with Lucia after the mission Down to Earth, in Chapter 1 — meditate there before you move on, because that moment does not come back. After that, find the other 17 meditation spots around Leonida in free roam and meditate at each. Sources agree this is the only time-gated spot; everything else in the list can be done after the story.
trophies.guide_short: Meditate at all 18 spots. MISSABLE: do the Chapter 1 balcony with Lucia after Down to Earth first — it does not return.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting job, follow the trail or marker to the animal's area, and take it down cleanly — a scoped rifle and patience beat spraying. One unique animal is enough for the trophy.
trophies.guide_short: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow his job to the animal, then take it down cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore, and trade or collect until three full sets are complete. Focus on one set at a time rather than grabbing at random, and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is still missing.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Focus on one set at a time and check what each set still needs.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is a long count, so build it into normal play: use the feature whenever you pass a new location instead of saving it for a grind at the end. The counter is cumulative, so every location you log counts towards the 100.
trophies.guide_short: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Log new places as you travel — the count is cumulative, so start early.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges cover many small tasks across the game, so this one fills up while you chase the other trophies — stunts, races, shooting and exploration all feed it. Check the challenges screen for the ones closest to done and finish those first.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 50 challenges. They fill up while chasing other trophies — finish the nearest ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight, switch to a fast car and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement — the same escape alone does not count.
trophies.guide_short: With your partner, reach 4 stars, then lose the wanted level and escape. Partner must be present.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. Plan a short route between three nearby shops, rob each in turn with your partner along, and keep the wanted level alive between them — if it drops to zero the chain breaks. A fast getaway car parked close to the third shop helps.
trophies.guide_short: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan three nearby shops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting in or driving a new vehicle model counts it as discovered, so try a different car, bike or truck whenever you see one you have not driven. The count builds naturally across the story and free roam; use the vehicle list to spot which types you are still missing.
trophies.guide_short: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive a new model whenever you see one — the count builds naturally.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Pick a busy fight rather than a lone enemy, and make sure you have enough ammo before you trigger it.
trophies.guide_short: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Pick a grouped fight and chain the takedowns before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get to the airport in free roam, take a plane and leave without following the scheduled route. Expect a wanted level for the stunt, so have a fast exit planned for after you are airborne.
trophies.guide_short: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA airport. Take a plane and leave off-schedule in free roam.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks — get into the thick of it with them. The description is deliberately vague, so the practical read is: find a Rhino, deal with the tank situation it creates, and survive it. Sources list it as a combat trophy tied to Rhinos; go in with heavy weapons and cover.
trophies.guide_short: Tied to the Rhino tanks. Find a Rhino situation, deal with it with heavy weapons and cover, and survive.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take what you need and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a clean, undetected run is the requirement.
trophies.guide_short: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go quiet, avoid cameras, and leave before any alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a planned job: get in, crack or open the vault, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives. You need five separate vault robberies, so space them out and keep a getaway vehicle ready. Note: the official list grades this silver — some early lists called it bronze, and the official grade is silver.
trophies.guide_short: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Five separate jobs — keep a getaway vehicle ready.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it — blocking it or disabling it — take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.
trophies.guide_short: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash, then lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, walk or fly into every named area until the map counts it as visited. Work region by region and use the map's area list to find the ones you have not entered yet — the last few are usually small spots on the edges of the map.
trophies.guide_short: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Work region by region and check the map for unvisited spots.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. You need one per gang, so keep a list of which gangs you have already hit and target the remaining ones. Each operation is a defended spot, so scout it first, then rob it and get clear.
trophies.guide_short: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Keep a list — one per gang, no repeats needed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach, order or enjoy a cocktail there, and stay for the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — no combat, no timer, just the right place at the right time of day for the view.
trophies.guide_short: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment — right place, no combat needed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car, and go through the front in one run. Expect a wanted level afterwards, so plan your exit.
trophies.guide_short: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in a car, through the glass, in classic style. Plan your exit.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there to its end. It is one of the activity types for Master of None, so if you have not tried bowling yet, this covers both trophies at once.
trophies.guide_short: Play bowling through at the Kolt & Associates alley. It also counts as one activity for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This is a partnership moment with mass appeal — a shared scene with your partner that the game counts as a milestone. The description is deliberately vague, so the practical advice is: keep playing the partner story beats and shared activities, and this pops when the right shared moment lands. Sources list it as story-adjacent, not a grind.
trophies.guide_short: A partnership moment with mass appeal. Keep playing the shared partner beats — it pops on the right one.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500 for this one. It builds up from the small decisions you make across the game, so there is no single mission to hunt: keep playing, keep choosing, and watch the count climb. It is a long tail trophy that finishes near the end of a full playthrough.
trophies.guide_short: Choices made — PSN tracks a count to 500. It builds up across the whole game; keep choosing.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second try after failing it once. The practical read is: fail a repeatable attempt, then succeed at the very next one. Do not overthink it: it pops naturally when a retry lands, so keep playing and it will come.
trophies.guide_short: Second time's the charm. Fail once, then succeed on the next try — it pops naturally on a retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's odd, unexplained moment. Explore the stranger corners of Leonida, especially at night and off the main roads, and this pops when you stumble into the right scene. It is a discovery trophy, so wandering pays off here.
trophies.guide_short: Witness something strange. Explore Leonida's odd corners, especially at night — it pops on discovery.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a person with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon from the car, and knock them down. Pick a quiet street so you can line it up without extra heat.
trophies.guide_short: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by from a moving vehicle. Slow pass, one clean swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to launder them, and the total builds up. Keep laundering after every big job instead of letting marked bills pile up, and this finishes during the story and cleanup.
trophies.guide_short: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Launder after every big job — it adds up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count, so this builds up naturally if you buy gear as you go. If you are short near the end, buy the most expensive useful items you still need rather than wasting money on things you will never use.
trophies.guide_short: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes and upgrades all count — it builds up naturally.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages appear for sale around Leonida — buy each one when you can afford it, and keep the money aside for the last few. Owning them also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
trophies.guide_short: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save money for the last few — they also store your discovered vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you have discovered, open the app, and register each one. Any 10 distinct vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most and top the list up with new finds as you explore.
trophies.guide_short: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 distinct vehicles count — register as you find them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
